item.title: How Did Flávio Bolsonaro Flee Brazil? ‘I’ll Take That to the Grave,’ He Says
item.description: From Miami, Flávio Bolsonaro is making unfounded claims of a stolen election and plotting to sway his nation’s politics from afar, even though his party is not challenging the results.

item.title: Bolsonaro’s Escape From Brazil Was Aided by Milei Adviser at Argentine Airport
item.description: A top adviser to President Javier Milei of Argentina met Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate, at an Argentine airport, three people involved in the operation said.

item.title: Iran is Reviewing ‘Concrete Proposals’ on Nuclear Program, Officials Say
item.description: Iran’s willingness to re-engage on the issue suggests that Qatar-led diplomatic efforts to avert full-blown war between the U.S. and Iran have had some success.

item.title: Bomb Threats Disrupt European Flights and Rattle Passengers
item.description: Passengers recounted landing at a military base and being subjected to security checks and travel delays after threats that turned out to be hoaxes affected planes in Italy, Poland and Spain.

item.title: Paraguay’s President, Santiago Peña, Quits Amid Ueno Bank Scandal
item.description: The president of the South American nation, Santiago Peña, has apologized for failing to prevent its worst financial crisis in decades.
